title: Generating a Fractal Microstructure of Laminin-111 to Signal to Cells
protocol: Thaw laminin-111 on ice in a refrigerator overnight.
Aliquot thawed laminin into low protein binding microcentrifuge tubes using low protein binding tips and sterile technique.
Freeze aliquoted laminin and store at -80 °C.
Make polyLM polymerization buffer by mixing 1 mM CaCl2 and 20 mM sodium acetate in ultrapure water.
Adjust the pH of the mixture to 4.0 using HCl or acetic acid.
Sterile filter the adjusted solution through a 0.2 μm filter.
Store filtered polyLM polymerization buffer at 4 °C.
Make control polymerization buffer by mixing 1 mM CaCl2 and 20 mM Tris in ultrapure water.
Adjust the pH of the mixture to 7.0 using 10 N HCl or 12 N NaOH as necessary.
Sterile filter the adjusted solution through a 0.2 μm filter.
Store filtered control polymerization buffer at 4 °C.
Using sterile cell culture technique, add the appropriate buffer to laminin aliquots at a final concentration of 100 µg/mL.
Mix gently by pipetting.
If using fluorescently tagged laminin for visualization, reconstitute and add at a 1:50 wt/wt ratio.
Transfer diluted laminins onto culture plastic or glassware immediately after dilution in appropriate buffer.
Incubate overnight in a cell culture incubator at 37 °C.
Wash with 1x phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
Remove the liquid carefully without allowing the surface to dry completely.
Incubate diluted laminins in a cell culture incubator at 37 °C for 30 min.
Centrifuge polyLM aliquots at 2,000 x g for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge LM in neutral pH at 20,000 x g for 20 minutes.
Remove the supernatant gently using sterile technique.
Resuspend in induction medium of DMEM-F12 supplemented with prolactin, hydrocortisone, and insulin.
Transfer laminin in cell culture medium immediately to stimulate cells.
Thaw recombinant nidogen-1 and Ln1 gently on ice overnight.
Mix Ln1 with nidogen-1 at a 1:1 wt/wt ratio in cell culture medium using low protein binding tips and tubes.
Use pure Ln1 in cell culture medium as a control.
Reconstitute fluorescently tagged laminin and add at a 1:50 wt/wt ratio.
Gently mix by pipetting.
Incubate Ln1-nidogen or control Ln1 in a cell culture incubator at 37 °C for 30 min.
Centrifuge Ln1-nidogen copolymers at 2,000 x g for 30 min.
Centrifuge the control Ln1 at 20,000 x g for 30 min.
Gently remove the supernatant.
Resuspend in cell culture medium to a final concentration of 100-800 µg total protein/mL.
Culture mammary epithelial cells in DMEM-F12 supplemented with 2% FBS, 0.01 mg/mL insulin, 0.005 µg/mL EGF, 0.05 mg/mL gentamycin, and 0.05 g/mL normocin.
Seed DgKI cells at 5,000 cells/cm² and seed DgKO cells at 8,000 cells/cm².
Culture the cells at 37 °C in humidified incubators with media changes every 2-3 days and passages every 4-5 days using rigorous sterile technique.
Count cells carefully with a hemocytometer or automated cell counter to ensure appropriate growth rates.
Seed cells for laminin stimulation at 10,500 cells/cm² in well plates or coverslip bottom dishes.
Culture the cells for 2 days before stimulating them with laminin.
Thaw Ln-1 gently overnight on ice in a refrigerator.
Mix Ln-1 with induction medium of DMEM-F12 supplemented with 3 µg/mL prolactin, 2.8 µM hydrocortisone, and 5 µg/mL insulin.
For a 35 mm dish, use 1 mL of induction media with 50-800 μg of Ln1.
If using fluorescent Ln1, mix in at 50:1 wt/wt ratio.
Remove media from cells.
Cover cells with laminin and induction media supplemented with prolactin, hydrocortisone, and insulin.
Culture cells for 2 days.
Fix cells with 10% formalin.
Collect fixed samples.
Wash samples three times with 1x PBS at room temperature for 5 minutes each.

Block and permeabilize samples in 1x PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100, 3% bovine serum albumin, 10% goat serum, and 40 µg/mL anti-mouse blocking antibody fragment for 1 hour at room temperature in a humidified chamber.
Mix anti-laminin antibody at a dilution of 1:100 with 1x PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 3% BSA, then add to samples.
Incubate samples with the primary antibody for 2 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C in a humidified chamber.
Wash samples three times with 1x PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 3% BSA.
Add an appropriate secondary antibody diluted to 1:500 in 1x PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 3% BSA, then incubate at room temperature in the dark for 1 hour in a humidified chamber.
Wash samples three times with 1x PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 3% BSA.
For samples containing cells, add 6 μM phalloidin for 45 min.
Wash samples three times with PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 3% BSA.
Stain samples with 0.1 μg/mL DAPI in PBS for 5 minutes.
Mount samples if appropriate.
Image ln-1 structure using high resolution confocal microscopy.
Analyze laminin constructs via box counting dimension algorithms available in Matlab toolboxes or ImageJ.
Resuspend laminins in cell culture media and allow to adsorb to silica wafers for 90 min in a humid 37°C environment.
Fix matrices in 2.5% glutaraldehyde in 0.1 M sodium cacodylate buffer at pH 7.2.
